method.comparison: Identical JS document model and scorer; only word indexing is enabled/disabled. Not a native comparison.
method.memory: Separate fresh processes, 3 trials of 8 strongly retained buffers, forced GC before/after. Bytes per buffer; negative scanning deltas are GC noise.
method.ui: Actual autocomplete package, model events and MutationObserver readiness, explicit layout. No timer polling in timed region.
method.validation: Measured model results are deep-equal to a scanner oracle. UI verifies item count and current first rendered label/highlight. Every source and driver hash is retained.
